">Full Stack Developer
5-7 Years PAN India
Python

Experience: 5-7 years of overall experience. 5+ years of relevant experience.
Responsibilities:
Build responsive, accessible, role-based user experiences for people transformation platform,
approvals, change control, workstream tracking, reporting, and administration.
Own implementation of the business-facing UI using React and TypeScript, ensuring usability and
accessibility for a diverse set of internal customers.
Develop backend APIs, relational data models, workflow services, scenario/version management,
and employee-level transaction logic using Python/FastAPI, Java/Spring, Node.js, .NET, or an
equivalent enterprise backend stack.
Implement a parallel workflow model supporting soft dependencies, hard dependencies, critical
path blockers, refresh requirements, approval invalidation, and stage-gate enforcement.
Build approval routing, final-lock controls, immutable audit events, reconciliation logic, dashboards,
CSV/EIB-ready exports, and API-ready integration interfaces.
Partner with the other engineer and Solution Architect to ensure implementation decisions align with
security, scalability, data protection, observability, and architectural standards.
Collaborate with PISD and cross-functional business partners to clarify requirements, resolve
ambiguity, and deliver solutions that align with Autodesk s compliance, privacy, and security
standards.
Represent engineering in product reviews and roadmap discussions by advocating for production
readiness, operational excellence, stakeholder needs, and scalable implementation patterns.
Required Qualifications:
5-7 years of software engineering experience, including ownership of complex production
applications.
Strong experience with a modern frontend framework such as React and TypeScript.
Strong backend experience with Python/FastAPI, Java/Spring, Node.js, .NET, or an equivalent
enterprise stack.
Experience designing relational data models, REST APIs, event-driven services, workflow engines,
and versioned business objects.
Demonstrated experience implementing role-based access control, approval workflows, audit
logging, and secure handling of sensitive data.
Strong understanding of automated testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment, logging, monitoring, and
application support.
Ability to work with business stakeholders and convert ambiguous operating processes into clear
system behavior.
Experience developing applications in which multiple teams act concurrently, and changes may
invalidate prior approvals or downstream outputs.
Successful track record collaborating with architects, product owners, and cross-functional
stakeholders to deliver production-ready internal tools.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience designing, building, or supporting integrations with enterprise HR, finance, or workforce
planning systems, such as Workday HCM, Workday Adaptive Planning, or similar platforms.
Experience with organizational modeling, scenario comparison, tree or hierarchy visualization, drag
and-drop structural design, or workforce analytics.
Familiarity with graph data models, temporal/versioned data, rules engines, or BPM/workflow
platforms.
Experience building internal enterprise products for global, multi-country users.
Familiarity with Autodesk products, platforms, or customer domains.


Primary Skills: Python/FastAPI, REST APIs, React and TypeScript, Enterprise Stack Build
Secondary Skills: Integrations with Workday HCM or other platforms, Organizational modeling,
BPM/Workflow platforms
